create_stacklstm: create a StackLSTM instance with an nn.LSTM to manage push pop and embedding operations
push_stacklstm_element: push a tensor expression and Element onto the StackLSTM stack for RNNG parsing
forward_compositionalnn: forward a list of tensor embeddings through CompositionalNN to combine them with a biLSTM
forward_compositionalsummationnn: forward a list of tensor embeddings through CompositionalSummationNN to combine them with summation
create_parserstate: create a ParserState with three StackLSTM instances to track buffer stack and action state
